record.oneLiner: Zoho CRM provides a broad REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0, accessible self-serve on free accounts with community MCP support.
record.verdictReason: Zoho CRM features comprehensive REST endpoints covering all core modules, robust OAuth 2.0 authentication obtainable self-serve on free developer accounts, and community-built MCP servers.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
To use the Zoho CRM APIs, the users must authenticate the application to make API calls on their behalf with an access token.
Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes the Zoho CRM v6 REST API as structured tools for LLM agents.
